$description: EDH Seer DRAWS NO SHADOWS. Not one box-shadow exists in the client (BuildBenchmarks.tsx says it in as many words: 'steps, never shadow'), so an elevation scale here would be five tokens nothing renders. Depth is a step up the ground ladder instead - see tokens/colors.json semantic.surface. The focus ring is the one thing in this file that ships, and it is an outline, not a shadow.

elevation.$description: Deliberately a single value. A raised element changes SURFACE (surface.card -> surface.raised -> surface.raised-2); it does not float.

focus-ring.$description: index.css: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px }`. Keyboard-only, so a mouse click never paints it. Inside the report's horizontally scrolling tab strip the offset flips to -2px, because `overflow-x` clips anything drawn outside a child's box - including its ring.

offset-inset.$description: for a control inside an overflow-x container
